messages:
Maria G: kicking off FRA1 edge cluster preflight — provisioning finished in cloud console but we need final validation before handing to platform team. Primary goals: verify GPU pool, network, SLO gates, cost/spot fallbacks, and model load smoke tests.

Aj Patel: quick checklist proposal:
- infra provision: control-plane, GPU pools (64x A10G spread across 4 racks)
- networking: BGP peers, MTU=9000, cloud firewalls for 9090/8080/8443, service CIDR, NAT gateway
- storage: PV quotas, NFS/GCS mounts, /mnt/models permissions
- security: KMS keys created, HSM not required, IAM roles for deployers
- autoscaler: test scale from 4->40 GPUs
- cost gating: spot fallback threshold 20% capacity loss
- SLOs: small infer p95 < 120ms, p99 < 400ms; model-load < 30s; node join < 120s
- smoke tests: health, model load, synthetic 5qps run, inference correctness checkset

Sam K: adding commands for smoke run:
```bash
# cluster basics
kubectl get nodes -o wide --context=fra1
kubectl get pods -n inference -o wide --context=fra1

# health endpoints
curl -sS http://inference.fra1.internal/health | jq .
curl -sS http://inference.fra1.internal/ready | jq .

# model load test
curl -X POST http://inference.fra1.internal/v1/load -d '{"model":"gpt-small","batch":1}' -H "Content-Type: application/json"

# quick perf probe (5 qps for 60s)
hey -q 5 -z 60s -c 5 -m POST -D payload.json http://inference.fra1.internal/v1/generate
```

Leo W: ops checks:
- nvidia-smi and driver: nvidia-smi topo -m; check nvidia driver >= 525
- check NVLink visibility for multi-GPU models
- dmesg for ECC errors
- kernel MTU: ip link show | grep mtu

infra-oncall: add monitoring SLO gates:
- prometheus rules to fire if p95_latency > 150ms for 5m
- node GPU memory pressure > 85% for 2m
- kubelet crashloop > 3 pods
- alert routing to #eng-oncall and pager

ops-bot: prov finished: cloud provider reports successful create: VPC, subnets, GWs, 4x GPU racks. config id: cfg-fra1-2026-03-01.

Maria G: runbooks for handoff:
1) run smoke tests (Sam commands)
2) validate autoscaler by draining a GPU node and ensure scheduler rebalances within 5m
3) run cost gating simulation: mark 20% of instances as preemptible and assert fallback to reserved pool
4) run security scan: image CVE check, IAM role access review
5) sign-off: product infra + security + oncall confirm in thread

Sam K: ran smoke tests, attached quick results:
- health: OK
- model load (gpt-small): 12s
- perf probe: p50 85ms, p95 140ms, p99 290ms
- autoscaler reacted in 3m20s when simulating load
- no driver errors, NVLink OK

Maria G: votes to handoff to eng-platform pending cost gating automation. @Leo W please confirm cost alert thresholds and we can schedule 1h walkthrough with platform.

Leo W: confirmed. I'll set alert for spot-loss > 15% and automatic fallback after 60s. I'll prep runbook doc and ping for a 1h handoff slot tomorrow. :thumbsup: 

deploy-bot: deploy pipeline for inference core ran: success: deploy-fra1-20260301-01.

infra-oncall: marking thread status: PREPARED -> ready_for_handoff

Maria G: thanks team — moving to handoff. :party_parrot:
